mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses corporate profit margins and raises discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is positive, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 0.5% over the prior month and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a weakening supply chain and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 have declined by at least 0.5% over the prior quarter, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior three months, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior month and the economy is in an early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production reading below 100 signals a supply chain disruption that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
